verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
[✲]By the sun and its growing brightness,
And by the moon when it follows it (the sun),
And by the day when it reveals its glory,
And by the night when it draws a veil over it,
w: it draws a veil over it

verses.en: And by the heaven and its making,
And by the earth and its spreading out,
And by the soul and its perfection —
And He revealed to it what is wrong for it and what is right for it —
w: and what is right for it

verses.en: And he who corrupts it is ruined.
The tribe of Thamud denied the truth because of their rebelliousness.
When the most wretched among them got up,

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَہُمۡ رَسُوۡلُ اللّٰہِ نَاقَۃَ اللّٰہِ وَسُقۡیٰہَا ﴿ؕ۱۴﴾
verses.en: Then the Messenger of Allah said, ‘Leave alone the she-camel of Allah, and let her drink.’

verses.ar: فَکَذَّبُوۡہُ فَعَقَرُوۡہَا ۪۬ۙ فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَیۡہِمۡ رَبُّہُمۡ بِذَنۡۢبِہِمۡ فَسَوّٰٮہَا ﴿۪ۙ۱۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]But they rejected him and hamstrung her, so their Lord destroyed them completely because of their sin, and made it (destruction) overtake all of them alike.
w: and made it (destruction) overtake all of them alike

verses.en: And He cared not for the consequences thereof.
